# Replace three-stage pure annealing with hybrid anneal→grow→window→anneal→hill pipeline: structural operations between annealing phases enable qualitatively different neighborhoods

Three sequential annealing stages at different temperatures failed (score 1.0, vs proven best 1.02375 from anneal→grow→window→hill). Pure annealing variants converge to local optima. Key insight: interleave structural mechanisms (grow, window) between annealing phases. After grow and window establish new set structure and boundaries, focused re-annealing explores configurations within that transformed space—something greedy hill climbing alone misses. This combines the proven 4-stage pipeline with multi-scale annealing wisdom: resetting annealing neighborhoods via structural changes enables deeper exploration than either approach alone. Respects 'anneal' branch focus while escaping pure-annealing local optimum.
